# Marketing Agent OS

> Marketing Agent OS is an open-source, cross-platform collection of 236 governed AI agent skills for marketing, SEO, generative engine optimization (GEO), answer engine optimization (AEO), content, CRO, paid media, lifecycle, social, analytics, growth, sales, and RevOps.

Canonical repository: https://github.com/iamwaqargulzar/Marketing-Agent-OS
License: Apache-2.0 for the wrapper and normalized layer; retained third-party licenses apply to pinned source snapshots.
Current version: 1.1.0
Last verified: 2026-08-11

- [Compatibility matrix](https://github.com/iamwaqargulzar/Marketing-Agent-OS/blob/main/docs/COMPATIBILITY.md): Harness paths, validation status, and support boundaries.

- [Audit report](https://github.com/iamwaqargulzar/Marketing-Agent-OS/blob/main/docs/AUDIT.md): Initial findings, corrected issues, and verified state.

## Installation

Interactive ecosystem install:

    npx skills add iamwaqargulzar/Marketing-Agent-OS

Clone and install:

    git clone https://github.com/iamwaqargulzar/Marketing-Agent-OS.git
    cd marketing-agent-os
    ./install.sh --agent universal --scope project --project /path/to/project

Windows PowerShell:

    .\install.ps1 -Agent universal -Scope project -Project C:\path\to\project

## Key facts

- 236 unique normalized Agent Skills.
- 14 direct installer targets.
- Linux, macOS, and Windows support.
- Agent Skills CLI 1.5.22 discovered all 236 skills and projected a selected skill across 76 registered agent definitions.
- OpenCode 1.18.15 discovered the package from native and universal paths.
- Four complete upstream snapshots are pinned by commit and tree hash.
- Upstream snapshots are provenance inputs and are never installed into harness skill directories.
- Instruction-only skills have no runtime dependency; optional helpers use Python 3 standard library.
